outcomes: An operator uses the production application builder to discover the exact migration registry
Apply and rollback commands expose every completed record before a later failure
Automation distinguishes user errors, operational failures, and detected drift by exit code
Every command closes dependency resources owned by the container created during application preparation
nonGoals: Starting HTTP servers, event consumers, application invokers, or background workloads
Owning backend-specific migration execution or atomicity
Treating inspect as guaranteed offline when plugins open dependencies during configuration

requirements.text: Every subcommand builds and prepares the service application to collect its registry but never starts runtime plugins or invokes application workloads.
Up, down, status, verify, and inspect reject unexpected arguments, forward explicit targets, and return stable exit codes for user, operational, and drift outcomes.
Record-producing commands emit parseable table, JSON array, or JSONL output, including a valid empty JSON result and records completed before an error.

Signals cancel in-flight registry work, while command return always closes any dependency container created during preparation using a fresh cleanup context, including when preparation itself or later registry work fails.
